description: This PHP source file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) class 'FIFOEntitlementConsumptionStrategyDao' responsible for managing leave entitlement periods in an HRM system, including transaction handling for updating leave period dates.

classes.name: FIFOEntitlementConsumptionStrategyDao
classes.description: DAO class for handling leave entitlement periods with FIFO strategy, providing methods for updating leave period dates with transaction safety.

methods.name: handleLeavePeriodChange
methods.description: Handles the change in leave periods when a leave period's start date is modified, updating current and future leave entitlements accordingly within a transaction.
